title: 30th Birthday Party Ideas: Themes, Food and Photos | Albums.ink
desc: 30th birthday party ideas for her or for him: themes, a backyard or at-home party, food, games and one QR code that collects every guest's photos and videos.
lead: Australians search “30th birthday party ideas”, “30th birthday party ideas for her”, “for him” and “at home” when a milestone is coming up. Here is a simple plan: a theme, the venue, food, a few games and an easy way to get every guest's photos afterwards.
body: ## Theme ideas
- Dirty thirty or Thirty, flirty and thriving – gold, black and balloons.
- Decades party: guests dress from the year they were born, or from the 90s.
- Summer garden party with fairy lights for a December or January birthday.
- Long lunch at a winery for a smaller group.
## At home or in the backyard
- A BBQ, a grazing table and an esky of drinks – BYO keeps costs down.
- Start in the arvo so older relatives can come and go before the night crowd arrives.
- Hire a few extra chairs and festoon lights rather than a venue.
## For her and for him
- For her: a picnic or high tea, a cocktail-making class, a dress-up theme.
- For him: a pub function room, a footy or cricket viewing party, a pizza night.
## Games and speeches
- Guess the year: baby and teen photos on a board, guests match them to the age.
- 30 things: friends each share one story or wish for the next decade.
- Keep speeches short – one from a parent, one from a best mate.
## Collect every guest's photos with one QR code
Everyone will take photos on their phones. With an event album on Albums they land in one place:
1. Create an album, for example “Sam's 30th”.
2. Put the QR code on the bar, the cake table or the invitation.
3. Guests scan it with the phone camera and upload photos and videos in the browser – nothing to install.
4. Turn on Hold guest photos to approve uploads before they appear.
5. Afterwards, download the whole album as one ZIP file.
Guests who upload without signing in appear anonymously. Signed-in guests also get a private draft copy of just their own uploads.

faq: What can I do for a 30th birthday party at home?
A backyard BBQ or grazing table, a simple theme, a photo board of the birthday person through the years and a short speech.
What is a good theme for a 30th?
Dirty thirty, a decades party, a garden party or a long lunch all work well.
How do I get photos from all the guests?
Share one QR code: guests upload photos and videos to the same album in the browser, and you can approve them first.
Do guests need to install anything?
No. Scanning the QR code opens the album in the phone's browser.
